intro.fr: Might and Magic VI se randomise avec le Might and Magic randomizer de rekurs.io, qui couvre les épisodes VI et VII.
intro.en: Might and Magic VI is randomized with rekurs.io's Might and Magic randomizer, which covers games VI and VII.

text.fr: New World Computing et 3DO sortent Might and Magic VI: The Mandate of Heaven en 1998.
text.en: New World Computing and 3DO release Might and Magic VI: The Mandate of Heaven in 1998.

text.fr: Le Might and Magic randomizer de rekurs.io, en version 2.6.2, mélange les objets, les monstres et certains PNJ de Might and Magic VI et VII.
text.en: rekurs.io's Might and Magic randomizer, at version 2.6.2, shuffles items, monsters and certain NPCs in Might and Magic VI and VII.
